parameters.content:
## Gmail integration — dry run first
Connect the same Gmail OAuth credential to the trigger and five HTTP nodes. Run a test poll with dry_run=true. Configure Gmail Triage is the only place to enable writes.

Labels and actions are suggestions until explicitly enabled in the Gmail companion. Configure Label Rules supports existing/new names, enabled and create_if_missing flags. Rules use literal terms, exact email addresses, and *@domain wildcards. No AI model or arbitrary custom regex. Score is not probability.

## 1. Normalize and validate
Gmail full MIME and parsed email fields → bounded text and filename metadata. Invalid fields, duplicate batch IDs, malformed rules go to Needs Review. Truncation is a warning: classify but never archive/read. Edit Configure Label Rules; email content cannot replace them.

## 2. Classify, protect, and plan
Weights: headers 40 (capped), sender 30, subject 25, body 15, attachment extension 15. Close matches → Needs Review. Security/critical patterns override bulk actions. The planner runs before Decision so every branch has the same envelope.

## 3. Inspect outcomes
Preview: planned Gmail changes, zero API writes.
Keep: no mailbox action.
Needs Review: invalid data, ambiguity, duplicates, or API failures. This is an output for inspection, not a persistent queue. Final outputs omit message text and sender.

## Deployment controls
dry_run=true; allow_create_labels=false; allow_archive=false; allow_mark_read=false.

No durable dedup ledger, automatic rate-limit backoff, or exactly-once guarantee. Repeated Gmail label changes are state-setting operations, but replay can override later human changes. Inspect the mailbox after an unknown write result. Use a test mailbox first. Execution saving is disabled in exports; manually viewing nodes still reveals email content.

## Demo expectations
Invoice → Triage/Invoices
OTP with bulk headers → Triage/Security, never archive/read
Newsletter → preview (archive switch initially off)
Failed deployment → Triage/Critical Alerts, never archive/read
VIP → Triage/Clients
Personal → Keep in Inbox
Ambiguous invoice/newsletter → Needs Review
Malformed input → Needs Review

Run node test-runner.js for regression and mocked Gmail checks.

## 4. Resolve Gmail label IDs
Only entered when dry_run=false. Exact user-label name lookup. Missing label → review unless creation explicitly enabled. Creation is followed by a fresh lookup; HTTP 409 also re-fetches once to handle concurrent creation. Other failures go to Needs Review.

## 5. Apply one Gmail modify request
One request adds category/STARRED and optionally removes INBOX/UNREAD. A final guard rejects unsafe or unresolved plans. Check returned message ID and label state before status=applied. Errors are routed to review; no unbounded retry.
